from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/chazu/dev/zig/birnam/scripts')
from validation_support import clean_environment
from logue_oracle import expected
w=Path('/tmp/birnam-runtime-tables/after-profile/logue/logue')
s=(w/'logue-bench.birnam').read_text().split('let results :=')[0]
s='[Globals at: #LogueBenchConfig put: {#phase -> "arena" #seed -> 12345 #width -> 16 #monsters -> 8 #turns -> 16 #batches -> 1 #samples -> 1 #allocation -> false #replace -> false}];\n'+s
s+='[benchArena value]; [System gc]; [System println: "ready"]; [System readLine];\n[[1 to: 16] do: [:i | [benchOperation value]]];\n[System println: [Json stringify: [benchState value]]]\n'
(w/'sample.birnam').write_text(s)
proc=subprocess.Popen(['/tmp/birnam-runtime-tables/candidate/bin/birnam','sample.birnam'],cwd=w,env=clean_environment(),stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
while True:
 line=proc.stdout.readline()
 if line.strip()=='ready': break
 if not line: raise RuntimeError(proc.communicate())
sampler=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/sample',str(proc.pid),'5','1','-file','/tmp/birnam-runtime-tables/after-profile/logue.sample.txt'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
time.sleep(.3);proc.stdin.write('\n');proc.stdin.flush()
out,err=proc.communicate(timeout=90); so,se=sampler.communicate(timeout=15)
Path('/tmp/birnam-runtime-tables/after-profile/logue.sample-output.json').write_text(out)
assert proc.returncode==0,(proc.returncode,err)
want=expected(dict(phase='arena',seed=12345,width=16,monsters=8,turns=256,batches=1,samples=1,replace=False))[0][0][0]
assert json.loads(out)==want
print('sample completed and 256-turn final state verified',sampler.returncode,so,se)

profiles.summarizer_source:
import re,collections,json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]; text=open(p).read().split('Call graph:\n')[1].split('Total number in stack')[0].split('Sort by top of stack')[0]
stack=[]; nodes=[]
for line in text.splitlines():
 m=re.match(r'([ +!:|]*)\b(\d+) (.+)',line)
 if not m: continue
 depth=len(m[1]); count=int(m[2]); name=m[3]
 while stack and stack[-1]['depth']>=depth: stack.pop()
 node={'depth':depth,'count':count,'self':count,'name':name,'ancestors':[x['name'] for x in stack]}
 if stack: stack[-1]['self']-=count
 nodes.append(node);stack.append(node)
libs=collections.Counter();symbols=collections.Counter(); total=0; wait=0; gc=0
for n in nodes:
 v=n['self']; assert v>=0,n
 if not v: continue
 total+=v
 m=re.search(r'\(in ([^)]+)\)',n['name']); libs[m[1] if m else 'unclassified']+=v
 sym=re.sub(r' \+ \d+.*','',n['name']); symbols[sym]+=v
 if any('read_nocancel' in a or '__read ' in a or a.startswith('read  (in libsystem_kernel') for a in n['ancestors']+[n['name']]): wait+=v
 if any('birnam_collect::collection::run' in a for a in n['ancestors']+[n['name']]): gc+=v
r={'samples':total,'waiting_samples':wait,'gc_run_inclusive':gc,'exclusive_libraries':dict(libs.most_common()),'top_exclusive_symbols':dict(symbols.most_common(30))}
print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))

qualification: Three fresh application runs per variant/workload, alternating baseline/candidate, sequential timing without profiling/builds/qualification running concurrently. Normal GC. Logue per-process medians cover four batches (generation one); JSON phase medians cover five repeats. JSON allocation pass separately disables automatic GC. Profiles are separate five-second sampled runs with checked final state. Performance prefix excludes TCC resource metrics; separate native validation enables them.
